mapper.insert: insert into material (material_code, name, type_id, unit, description, status, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{materialCode}, #{name}, #{typeId}, #{unit}, #{description}, #{status}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update material set is_del = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select m.id, m.material_code, m.name, m.type_id, mt.name as type_name, mt.description as type_description, mt.type_code as type_code, m.unit, m.description, m.status, m.is_del, m.create_time, m.update_time from material m left join material_type mt on m.type_id = mt.id where m.id = #{id} and m.is_del = 0

select m.id, m.material_code, m.name, m.type_id, mt.name as type_name, mt.description as type_description, mt.type_code as type_code, m.unit, m.description, m.status, m.is_del, m.create_time, m.update_time from material m left join material_type mt on m.type_id = mt.id where m.material_code = #{materialCode} and m.is_del = 0
mapper.update: update material set material_code = #{materialCode}, name = #{name}, type_id = #{typeId}, unit = #{unit}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from material where type_id = #{typeId} and is_del = 0
